# mcp/tests/fixtures/old_coherence_record_l39.json

## Governing Overview

[Test route overview](../overview.md)

## Purpose

Retain the complete pre-capacity-derivation L39 curator-coherence record as immutable compatibility input.

## Boundaries

The fixture preserves the original record encoding, typed leaf identity and dependency declaration. It is consumed by the production-model backward-loading test; it is not the current coherence authority for any live leaf and must not be substituted for unavailable historical evidence.

## Evidence

- Complete historical record encoding is retained as test input. [1]
- The production record model parses this exact fixture. [2]
